mapper.sql: id, user_id, question_id, practice_record_id, content, model, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_explanation (user_id, question_id, practice_record_id, content, model) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{practiceRecordId}, #{content}, #{model}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE practice_record_id = incoming.practice_record_id, content = incoming.content, model = incoming.model, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
